jobDescription: Work orders, materials and quality holds in the company's two electronics assembly plants live in the factory execution system, and the supervisors on the line learn every screen change from the engineer who built it. This engineer builds the changes the process engineers specify, runs them on the pilot line before anyone on a live line sees them, teaches the supervisors on the line during a running shift, and files a note of what each change leaves alone. Releases need the execution system lead's go-ahead. Reports to the execution system lead; works with the process engineers, the plant supervisors and the automation vendor.
requirements: Builds execution system changes to the process engineers' specifications under the plant software standard.
Teaches supervisors each change on the line during a running shift under the line training standard.
Runs every change on the pilot line first, with the pilot record kept.
Gets the execution system lead's go-ahead for every release and records which checks were own.
Files a note of what each change leaves alone and the hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Execution system engineer at an electronics manufacturer for four years across two assembly plants, building the changes the process engineers specified under the plant software standard.

Taught the supervisors each change on the line during a running shift under the line training standard; sixty-one line sessions across the two plants, every one with a supervisor-signed training record.
Every change ran on the pilot line first, with the pilot record filed against the change and countersigned by the process engineer.
The execution system lead gave the go-ahead for every release, recorded on the change alongside the checks that were mine.
A note of what the change leaves alone and what the next engineer needs to know sits at the end of every change record.
Work sample: two change records with pilot records, the lead's go-ahead and the notes, and three supervisor-signed training records, with the change system references as a verification trail.

Interviewer 2 note: asked to train the panel as line supervisors on a sample change, the candidate showed the new quality hold screen on the tablet, had each panel member release a sample hold themselves, pointed out the one step that differed from the old screen, and handed over a one-page card with the three steps.
Reference call with the execution system lead: confirmed the line sessions and the pilot-line rule, that the go-ahead sat with the lead, and confirmed the employment dates.

propositions.rationale: The resume and the change records document the changes and the pilot records.

propositions.rationale: The resume, the training records and the reference call document the line sessions and the go-ahead boundary.
